This crude expression for childbearing needs a vulgarity warning beyond the colloquial tag.
Cung nghinh means to receive or escort someone or something reverently, not simply to participate in a procession.
flags.fix: to ceremonially escort (a deity or sacred image)

flags.why: Walking behind a palanquin does not by itself constitute cung nghinh, which requires an object being reverently received or escorted.
flags.fix: Dân làng cung nghinh tượng thần về đình. = The villagers ceremonially escorted the deity's statue to the communal house.
